description.value: Superflux Beer Company is a craft brewery and taproom nestled between Strathcona and East Vancouver, specializing in IPA alongside a broader range of styles including lagers and pale ales. The brewery offers a full food menu with seating both indoors and on a covered patio, and operates an on-site beer store selling cans to go. The /home page title also identifies it as a dog-friendly brewery, which may appeal to cyclists travelling with pets.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands at 33m; stands at 35m; stands at 38m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at superfluxbeer.com confirms Superflux Beer Company is an active brewery and taproom at 505 Clark Drive, Vancouver, open 7 days a week with food service, indoor seating, and a covered patio. Takeout is confirmed via 'CURRENTLY AVAILABLE AT THE BREWERY - IN CANS TO GO' and 'off-sales' references. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those fields remain null. A minor postal code discrepancy exists: OSM and the /home subpage show V5L 3H6, while the front page and /visit-us show V5L 3H7.
concerns: Postal code discrepancy: OSM and the website's /home subpage show V5L 3H6, but the front page and /visit-us subpage show V5L 3H7. The street address is consistent across all sources.
No phone number available in OSM tags or on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible brewery and taproom open 7 days a week with food, beer to go, and a covered patio — a useful stop for touring cyclists in East Vancouver.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website page title on /home identifies the venue as 'Dog Friendly Brewery', which may be worth surfacing in the listing for cyclists travelling with dogs.
